title: New law: A bill to amend section 236 of the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement Act of 1964 for Certain Employees to limit the number of employees that may be retired under such Act during specified periods. (Public Law 93-31)
summary: S. 1494 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-31 on 1973-05-08.

title: New law: An Act to authorize further appropriations for the Office of Environmental Quality, and for other purposes. (Public Law 93-36)
summary: S. 1379 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-36 on 1973-05-18.

title: New law: An Act to authorize appropriations for the Indian Claims Commission for fiscal year 1974, and for other purposes. (Public Law 93-37)
summary: S. 721 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-37 on 1973-05-24.

title: New law: An Act to amend the Rural Electrification Act of 1936, as amended, to establish a Rural Electrification and Telephone Revolving Fund to provide adequate funds for rural electric and telephone systems through insured and guaranteed loans at interest rates which will allow them to achieve the objectives of the Act, and for other purposes. (Public Law 93-32)
summary: S. 394 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-32 on 1973-05-11.

title: New law: Older Americans Comprehensive Services Amendments of 1973 (Public Law 93-29)
summary: S. 50 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-29 on 1973-05-03.

summary: S.J.Res. 51 of the 93rd Congress became Public Law 93-30 on 1973-05-05.

title: New law: A bill to provide for the striking of medals in commemoration of Roberto Walker Clemente. (Public Law 93-33)
